title: Whitfield course completion by term
brief: Whitfield College's institutional research office, led by Dr. Aaliyah Brandt, is preparing a course completion summary for the academic senate meeting on 2026-11-10. Term by term, the number of students enrolled in online and blended courses and the number who completed with a passing grade. Fall 2024: 1240 enrolled, 868 completed (70.0 percent). Spring 2025: 1315, 947 (72.0). Fall 2025: 1410, 1086 (77.0). Spring 2026: 1502, 1187 (79.0). For Spring 2026 by delivery format: in person 520 enrolled, 447 completed (86.0 percent); hybrid 600, 480 (80.0); online 382, 260 (68.1). Points for the senate: completion is up 9 points in four terms; the biggest single jump, 5 points, came in Fall 2025 when free tutoring for first-year students started on 2025-08-25; and online courses still complete about 18 points below in-person ones, so online is the format with the most room to improve. Sections: "Completion at a glance", "Term by term", "By format, Spring 2026" and "Notes". In the notes, remind readers that completed means a passing grade, not attendance, and that withdrawals before the census date on the 15th day of the term are not counted as enrolled.

edit.request: Spring 2026 enrollment was corrected to 1512 with the same 1187 completions, so completion is 78.5 percent, and online enrollment is 392, so online completion is 66.3 percent.
